Etymology tree
Proto-Slavic *kъňiga
Russian кни́га (kníga)bor.
Lithuanian knyga
Borrowed from Russian кни́га (kníga, “book”), from Proto-Slavic *kъňiga.

žmogùs m (plural žmónės)

A u-stem, replacing and related to the Old Lithuanian n-stem žmuõ, with a non-etymological suffix -g of unclear derivation (traditionally derived from Proto-Indo-European *gʷeh₂- (“to go”) > góti).

        human rights
      2. man
